data_sources.rule: metadata is used only for contract/event semantics; no price behaviour is used to infer semantics

b1_holdout.b1_configuration: use selection.baseline.B1 lag_depth and alpha already chosen on DEV; no retuning
metrics: challenger pooled MSE improvement vs B1
challenger pooled MSE improvement vs B2
median per-target MSE improvement vs B1

multiplicity.loss_advantage: (y - B2)^2 - (y - challenger)^2 on every jointly valid target-time cell
multiplicity.observed_statistic: 100 * pooled loss advantage / pooled B2 squared-error; this equals percentage pooled MSE improvement versus B2
multiplicity.null: one-sided synchronized blocked wild bootstrap under zero incremental mean advantage
multiplicity.centering: subtract each frozen cell's pooled observed mean loss advantage from every valid target-time loss-advantage observation in that cell
multiplicity.synchronization: one Rademacher sign per family-hour per draw; the same sign is applied to all grids, horizons, panels and targets from that family-hour; families are independently randomized because their historical periods are disjoint
multiplicity.max_statistic: maximum null percentage pooled improvement across all 35 frozen cells in each draw
multiplicity.adjusted_p: (1 + draws with max_statistic >= observed strongest-cell statistic) / (draws + 1)
multiplicity.unadjusted_p: same blocked null but cell statistic compared only with that cell's null draws
multiplicity.dependence_summary: participation-ratio effective rank of the 35x35 correlation matrix of null cell statistics across draws

dependence_sensitivity.optional_rule: include 120 minutes only when n_valid / block_rows >= 2
dependence_sensitivity.loss_series: existing per-decision-time mean B2 loss minus challenger loss over jointly valid targets
dependence_sensitivity.instability_rule: if effective_blocks < 2, report mean/effective-block count and mark CI INSUFFICIENT_EFFECTIVE_BLOCKS rather than treating a numerical CI as inferential

semantics.market_membership: use the five frozen panel_markets only
semantics.sources: canonical metadata keyed only by condition_id/event_id plus reconstructed economic observation timestamps

coefficient_map.source_ranking: within each target, rank other source markets by L2 norm across all coefficients belonging to that source (returns, masks and ages)
coefficient_map.display_count: all four cross-market sources per target
coefficient_map.own_history: report own-source grouped L2 coefficient norm and signed standardized-return coefficients for each frozen lag
coefficient_map.cross_market: report grouped L2 norm, signed standardized-return coefficients by lag, and dominant signed return coefficient

temporal_concentration.block_advantage: sum of target-time B2 squared-error minus challenger squared-error over jointly valid observations
temporal_concentration.half_split: chronological active-hour blocks; first floor(n/2) active blocks vs remaining blocks
temporal_concentration.removal: remove top 1 and top 3 positive active-hour blocks ranked by raw block loss advantage, ties UTC ascending; recompute pooled percentage MSE improvement versus B2 on remaining observations

interpretation.cross_sectional_question: ranking which markets move more at the same timestamp
interpretation.time_series_question: improving each market's future-movement forecast through time
